description:
Individual buys and sells by tracked wallets in one token, most recent first,
    each with the market cap at the moment of the trade. Use for the sequence of
    events, for example whether KOLs bought before or after a price move, or with
    since to check what happened after a given time.

    blockchain: solana, bnb, base, eth or rh
    mint: token address
    wallet_type: restrict to kol, smart or whale. Omit to merge all types.
    limit: how many transactions (default 25)
    since: only trades at or after this time (inclusive)
    cursor: pagination.next_cursor from the previous page, with the same limit

blockchain.description: Blockchain. One of: solana, bnb, base, eth, rh. solana has kol, smart and whale wallets; bnb, base, eth and rh have kol and smart. rh is Robinhood Chain, an Ethereum L2.
blockchain.title: Blockchain

cursor.description: Pagination cursor taken from the previous response. Leave empty for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: How many entries to return. Keep it small: large results are trimmed to fit the context window anyway.
limit.title: Limit

mint.description: Token address: the mint on Solana, the contract address on the EVM chains.
mint.title: Mint

since.description: Only trades at or after this time: ISO 8601 (UTC), Unix seconds or milliseconds. Pass the created_at of the newest trade already seen to get only new ones; a check that finds nothing new costs no credits. Leave empty for the latest trades.
since.title: Since

wallet_type.description: Restrict to one wallet type: kol, smart or whale. Leave empty to merge all types the chain has.
wallet_type.title: Wallet Type

name: get_token_transactions
